description: This header file declares exported functions for the HTTP HFP Module Container Object related to a BroadWay Content Filtering Container. It includes function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the container.

methods.name: ContFilterCreateModuleContainer
methods.description: Creates a module container object with specified context handles.

methods.name: ContFilterMcoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Content Filtering Module Container Object.

methods.name: ContFilterMcoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the specified container object.

methods.name: ContFilterMcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the container object.
